description: Header file defining the DrmSystemPlayready class for PlayReady DRM integration on Windows, including license management and session handling.

classes.name: DrmSystemPlayready
classes.description: Class that adapts PlayReady DRM to Starboard's SbDrmSystem interface, managing licenses and sessions.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Abstract class representing a DRM license, with methods for license management and decryption.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new License object with provided initialization data.

methods.name: key_id
methods.description: Returns the key ID associated with the license.

methods.name: usable
methods.description: Checks if the license is usable.

methods.name: UpdateLicense
methods.description: Updates the license with new license data.

methods.name: GenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Generates a session update request with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with a key and session ID.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes a session identified by session ID.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Retrieves a license object for a given key ID.

methods.name: UpdateServerCertificate
methods.description: Updates the server certificate (not supported, empty implementation).

methods.name: GetMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics data (not supported, returns NULL).
